description: Called him clear, and left the plot on the peg.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Looked up from tuning, and down, and would not name it.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Laughed at the gardener. They had no other line.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: In the lords' room, arms folded. He did not speak.
name: James Burbage

description: Was exact in the lengthened gown, and did not stop for the grain.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Lost the crown behind the curtain, and kept the street.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Took the only laugh, from the hired men.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Ate the apple, and said it wants a dog.
name: Will Kemp

description: Played the afternoon, and stayed on this bank.
name: William Shakespeare
